meta.notes: Rows follow the parent-approved 41-row core scope. Each row represents a durable map or stage group, not each individual act/reward line. Challenge rotations, Portals, Tournaments, Leaderboards, Stage Notes archive rows, and removed/limited-only modes are intentionally excluded. World Destroyer Gamemode is also excluded from the 41-row data pass because it reuses Frozen Port as a special infinite mode and would duplicate the Story map in this compact map-group catalog; it remains a source for later special-mode expansion if desired. Image paths are intentionally blank at the data gate; the image skill should fill clean map/stage images where available.
imageNotes: Image pass resolved one clean map image per row from Fandom Map:* pages by reading each mapImage filename and MediaWiki imageinfo URL.
Rows with duplicate visible names are wired by slug so Story, Legend Stage, Rift, and PvP variants do not overwrite each other.
All map/stage images are stored under apps/web/public/Anime Vanguards/Maps Stages and referenced through /Anime%20Vanguards/Maps%20Stages/*.png paths.

items.cardSummary: The Almighty's Realm is a Rift on Kuinshi Palace where boss vulnerability timing is the central mechanic.
